pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit complex, jagged, star-like geometries on the flank with high-frequency edge angularity. On the neck, patches transition to more compressed, irregular polygonal shapes with sharp pixel-level gradients against the background.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-toned pathways forms a topological mesh. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-axial intersections. Pixel thickness of the corridors is non-uniform, often tapering at the vertices of the patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the dorsal neck as a short, erect, linear structure with a fine-grained, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark avian figures (oxpeckers) are clustered on the lateral and dorsal surfaces of the upper neck and shoulder region.
